verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application platform, so asking about edge or serverless functions is a fair question. However, the evidence pack never documents an edge or serverless functions product, or the Node.js compatibility of such a runtime. Docker support and long-running services are an adjacent deployment model, not the edge/serverless capability this story asks about, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run unmodified Node.js code and npm packages in edge/serverless functions instead of a restricted runtime subset
